question.prompt: To construct a point representing an irrational number on the number line, construct a right triangle with legs of lengths 1 and 3. Draw an arc centered at the origin with radius equal to the hypotenuse length, intersecting the positive half of the number line at point \(P\). What is the square of \(OP\)?

solutions.explanation: \(OP\) equals the hypotenuse length, so \(OP^2=1^2+3^2=10\). Thus, point \(P\) represents \(\sqrt{10}\).
solutions.title: Square of the transferred hypotenuse
